canonical_form_note: String hashes use UTF-8 bytes of YAML-safe-loader string values; non-strings as JSON sorted keys ensure_ascii=false separators=(",", ":").

matching_rules.BQ1: Scan each of the six files as raw UTF-8 text (including # comments). An occurrence is any match of: (a) deictic "this/that/THIS file|amendment|text|protocol|contract|experiment|specification|document|record|table|layer"; (b) definite description "the [frozen] specification|contract|amendment|experiment|protocol|text|record|table|document|file|governing text|held text|held stack|primary source|named source"; (c) file name or path token (specification.yaml, AMD-*.yaml, experiments/EXP-AUXIN-7e2e3d/..., implementation/..., inputs/..., ledger/..., coordination/..., trial-plan.json, orders.json, etc.); (d) amendment.<path> or experiment.<path> field references; (e) layer names; governing_text_table; held X; (f) record-id tokens (EXP|H|DEC|TASK|RUN|CORR|REVIEW|IDEA|VAL|RT|BATCH|GOAL|RQ|AMD-EXP-...). Offset is the UTF-8 byte offset of the match start. Field path is the YAML leaf containing the match when mappable; else #comment_or_header or #unmapped_raw. Overlapping pattern matches at the same span are collapsed to the longest phrase; distinct spans are all kept.
matching_rules.BQ2: YAML string leaves whose text states a run-time (or launch-time / stage-boundary) decision that depends on bytes, sha256/digest, dirty_summary/cleanliness, presence, or archiving of a named file, path, or record. Includes D8_custody, incorporates.hash_check, governing-text hash stops, dirty launch refusal, orders.json.sha256 commitment, snapshot path_sha256 requirements, staged-source digest checks, and cert_verify.py version=sha256-of-bytes. Excludes bare 64-hex span identifiers, governing_text_table.via pointers, and stopping/control rules that do not mention file digest/dirty/archive dependence.
matching_rules.BQ3: Every YAML string leaf or header-comment block that states a normative rule on revision, approval, custody, write_scope, or reading_of_references (including provenance-only / unopened / Q0 conventions / cites blocks that declare reading rules). Classify each as protocol_content (binds what may be revised/approved/written/read) vs machinery_only (tooling without protocol force). In this inventory all retained rows are protocol_content.
